description: Get a wallet's current SOL balance. Use it to check a wallet can cover a transfer or fee, or that funds arrived. Returns {wallet, network, balance_sol}. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL) after the 27-call trial. Example: {"wallet":"<wallet address>"}

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

wallet.description: Wallet whose SOL balance to read: base58 public key, 32-44 characters (required).

name: get_solana_balance
